evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched 'A rollback we have not X is a rollback we do not Y' structure sets rehearsed vs. actually-have in deliberate opposition within one frame — parallel antithesis.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnowned
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses where what is unrehearsed is declared equivalent to what is unowned?
